benchmark_unit: 45-second target interval; alert in first 15 seconds
unknowns: report separately and include in end-to-end detection denominator; never silently relabel TN/FN
fit_data: normal training prefix only; calibration uses normal suffix
exposed_attack_matrix: descriptive diagnosis only; not a fresh confirmation of revised candidate
final_validation_requires: freeze complete telemetry/model/policy; new unseen attack and normal intervals; independent label review
hard_safety_or_integrity_failure: retain evidence; stop dispatch or quarantine affected interval, not erase/restart the campaign
